summary: Iteration 21: tested the 4 new features: WebP + lazy images, French contact-form validation, the ERP 'Demandes de porte' table with structured door_* fields, and SMS 'texto' links. Backend: 31/31 pytest passed (new test_door_requests_iter21.py plus the iter20 regression). Frontend: all flows passed on desktop and mobile.

issues: The right-aligned 'Qté' column sits right against the 'Dimensions' column (3 | 72" × 84" looks glued together). Add padding-right or left-align it.

action_items: Optional: add maxLength to the door_width/door_height inputs (backend limit 40) and to door_qty (limit 20). Today a longer value only gets the generic 422 message in French.
Optional: remove the duplicate loading="lazy" props on the tags in PortesAluminium.jsx (lines ~273/276, 388/391, 414/417, 422/425). JSX duplicate props produce a lint warning.
Optional: add an aria-label to the icon-only door-requests-refresh button.
critical_code_review_comments: The contact form uses noValidate together with a custom French validate(). Native English browser bubbles are correctly bypassed, and a 422 falls back to a French message. Good.
GET /admin/door-requests: the $or/$nin filter correctly excludes plain submissions. It requires auth, excludes _id and is capped at 1000 rows (no pagination).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ submissions, then deleted all TEST_-prefixed contact_submissions (103) and their linked erp_jobs (103)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: the 11 alu-*.webp files are valid WebP, 5-35x smaller than PNG, with naturalWidth>0 on /portes-aluminium and the home page. The hero background is alu-hero.webp. On /contact?produit=aluminium the door panel opens automatically; email 'abc' gives 'Veuillez indiquer une adresse courriel valide.' and an empty message gives 'Veuillez écrire un court message…'. A valid submit returns 201 with structured door_* fields and shows contact-success. On the ERP tab /admin/gestion/demandes-porte the rows show gamme/config/qty/dims/fini. nav-sms, mobile-nav-sms, footer-sms and contact-info-sms all point to sms:+14383764177.
